title: Reservations activation ops-lane for new region SKUs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: coordinate activation of reserved capacity SKUs for the new eu-north-2 region and two compact instance types (g6x-compact, c5y-compact) while minimizing customer downtime and ensuring billing/telemetry alignment. Scope: release notes bullet drafting, console flag gating for early customers, billing schema updates, telemetry segments and dashboards, sales enablement collateral, partner-facing activation checklist, and ops runbook for post-activation incidents. Acceptance criteria: (1) release notes approved by legal/finance; (2) console toggle and migration path validated in staging; (3) billing events instrumented and validated against test invoices; (4) telemetry dashboards show correct reservation consumption and per-sku latency/cost breakdowns; (5) ops runbook + incident playbook reviewed and signed off by SRE. Out-of-scope: pricing model changes beyond mapping new SKUs to existing tiers, migration automation for legacy reservations (handled by PM-9521). Key deliverables: release-notes draft (Confluence), migration checklist (Drive), billing schema PR (GitHub), reservations telemetry dashboard (Looker), ops runbook (Confluence), partner enablement deck (Google Slides). Owners: PM (Aisha Patel) for GTM and release notes, Eng (Marco Ruiz) for schema and console toggle delivery, SRE (Liang Chen) for runbook and rollback plan, Design (Sana Kim) for console UX microcopy and banners. Launch cadence: soft activation (canary) to 5 enterprise customers on 2025-03-18, broad activation target 2025-03-25 contingent on canary metrics.
